hook: The blood-brain barrier lets 92 plasma proteins into the mouse brain, such as APOA1 for astrocytes.

readout.label: Proteins sampled by the healthy blood-brain barrier

summary: Labeling proteins with bioorthogonal proteomics, the team found the barrier samples 191 plasma proteins and passes 92 into brain tissue, each homing to particular cell types. APOA1 crosses via SR-B1 and drives cholesterol efflux in astrocytes; boosting it rescued deficits in early-stage 5xFAD Alzheimer's mice. All of this is in mice, and human relevance is untested.
title: The blood-brain barrier imports diverse neuroprotective proteins through pathways impaired early in Alzheimer's disease models.
